lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Subordinate.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: How's it going getting her to give up the marine animals?
Not so good.
It's coming along.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I figured as much.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: But you still haven't gotten there yet, correct?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I knew this would be tough,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: but I didn't realize it would eat up this much of your time.
How are things on your end?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I'm trying to come up with alternative solutions as well.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I've also been trying to appeal to the bureau and get them to compromise.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Just a moment ago, I went to the head office.
At Elysion?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: They're the ones who manufactured us,

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: so I went there to see if there was any way they could lend us any assistance.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Unfortunately, all I got was a stern lecture

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: about how it was morally questionable for a corporate entity like Elysion to
Wait...

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: involve themselves in the affairs of an independent body like the bureau,
but I think I know where we can turn to.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: What do you mean?
